notes.title: Play the 12 new levels now!
notes.content:
Hi there Fruity Smoothies! The new update is live which means you can now play a lot of new levels. The final release will have 21 levels, which is 12 levels more than the new release. The first 9 levels are also made better!

Now you will be able to play as a pineapple and orange too. We also made a better Single Player experience by adding also the possibility to switch between characters and offering the change to let you change the keyboard controls.

ADDED:
- New levels, including Vegetable Bosses
- A rewardingsystem
- New characters to play with
- The possibility to switch between players in Single Player
- The possibility to change the keyboard controls
- Bugfixes
- More Fruitpuns
- Many more...

Have fun with this new release. Thank you all for being bad parents and throwing your fruitchildren in the blender! We enjoyed making this game for you!

notes.title: Patch notes 23/12/2017
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes 23/12/2017[/h1]

This patch contains mostly bug fixes, as well as improved controls for the boat. New levels and features will be coming early January 2018!

[u]Gameplay[/u]
[list]
[*] Changed the way controlling the boat in the road map works. It should be a lot easier to navigate.
[*] Added more decoration to certain levels.
[/list]

[u]Bug fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Players can't throw children into cannons while the children are not near you.
[*] Fixed accidental spawn point locations breaking certain levels.
[*] Increased the size of the water level meter in the UI to make it more visible.
[*] Made it easier to cross bridges for both players and fruit children.
[*] Players won't get pushed through fences by the evil cucumbers anymore.
[*] Removed the random chance to instantly drown at the start of level 2.
[*] The campfire in level 3 no longer burns underwater.
[/list]
